what: Generative Latin grooves. Let the band play, ¡tú al solo! Press PLAY and a band on the clave plays: sampled congas, bongos, timbales and bells, a montuno on an upright piano, a tumbao bass and the horns, from salsa and mambo to bolero and tango. Fire the band's hits, send the horns into a mambo, and take the solo trumpet on the keys, muted and placed around your head.
author: delirioux
